_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.386 improves SysID interpretation of curved sealed pressure decay. A shifted pulse vote pinned near30bpm is corroborated against the complete sealed observation, preserving detected complete-window pulses and all original measurement and safety gates. Rejected fits now retain their exact input arrays and sealed context for reproducible diagnosis.

Validation:781SysID/installer/publication tests and all7application smoke checks passed, including standalone/GUI preset parity. The new regression preserves detected primary and backup pulses across1120known-input cases. Recorded Run12 reconstruction increases supported fits from9to14of21windows; unresolved cases remain rejected.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-351. Production protocols, calibration, saved tuning and accepted fleet profiles are unchanged. Local leakage-aware research identification is distinct from complete pressure-range and sustained-control qualification; no partial large-cuff model is adopted as tuning.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
